summary.en: Pakistani security forces recently conducted raids on militant hideouts, killing 74 militants in one operation and 22 militants in another, targeting TTP elements. A passenger coach collided with an LPG bowser on the Makran coastal highway near Ormara, killing ten civilians, and a separate bus-gas tanker crash killed ten people elsewhere in Pakistan. A Pakistani minister travelled to India for a SCO meeting, while senior military commander CDF Munir was briefed on ongoing operations during a visit to Balochistan. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomførte nylig raid på militant skjulesteder, og drepte 74 militante i én operasjon og 22 militante i en annen, rettet mot TTP-elementer. En passasjervogn kolliderte med en LPG-båser på Makran-kystveien nær Ormara, og drepte ti sivile, og en separat buss-gass-tankerkrasj drepte ti personer et annet sted i Pakistan. En pakistansk minister reiste til India for et SCO-møte, mens senior militærkommandør CDF Munir ble orientert om pågående operasjoner under et besøk i Balochistan. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
